description:
Classic port knocking and SPA (Fwknop) client + Wake-on-LAN FwKnop-ng is an Android client to open firewall ports and wake machines remotely. It supports fwknop (Single Packet Authorization), classic port knocking and Wake-on-LAN. With fwknop, it sends an encrypted, authenticated SPA packet that makes a fwknopd server open a firewall port for your IP address. With classic port knocking, it sends a configurable sequence of ports with a delay between packets. With Wake-on-LAN, it wakes up a machine on your network. Features
  • Three modes: fwknop SPA, classic port knocking and Wake-on-LAN
  • Rijndael (AES) and GPG (via OpenKeychain) encryption, HMAC authentication
  • Configurations stored encrypted (Android Keystore, Tink, SQLCipher)
  • Optional app lock (biometrics or device credential)
  • Encrypted backup and restore of all configurations
  • Import/export of configurations through QR codes
  • NFC tag triggered knocks
Note: configurations are bound to the device's Android Keystore. Removing the screen lock or a factory reset makes them unrecoverable: keep your fwknop keys elsewhere, or use the encrypted backup.
